title: Limit preservation is stable under 2-fibre products
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file artin.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: For (1): given (T, x, z, alpha) over T = lim T_i, limit preservation of X and Z produces x_i and z_i over some T_i, and the isomorphism alpha descends to some alpha_{i'} over T_{i'} by limit preservation of Y; after replacing i by i' the quadruple (T_i, x_i, z_i, alpha_i) restricts to the original; statement (2) is the same argument with morphism-level data, with full faithfulness omitted as mechanical.
